title: About Subtle Sway
metaDescription: Subtle Sway makes printable wall art for calm, lived-in rooms. Every design is sold as an instant digital download on Etsy.
body:
Subtle Sway is a small, independent studio making printable wall art for calm, lived-in rooms: painterly landscapes, moody florals, botanical studies and simple prints for kitchens and everyday spaces.

Every design is sold as an **instant digital download** through our [Etsy shop]({{etsyShopUrl}}). You buy the files once, print them at home or at a local print shop, and frame them the way you like. Nothing physical is shipped, so there is no waiting and no shipping cost.

## How the art is made

Our artwork is designed by us with digital tools, including AI-assisted generation. Each piece is then selected, edited, colour-corrected and prepared as high-resolution print files at 300 DPI.

## Why this site exists

This site is a quiet gallery of our prints, so you can see every room mockup and the full details in one place. When you find a piece you like, the **Buy on Etsy** button takes you to the listing, where the purchase and the download are handled by Etsy.

title: Printable art FAQ
metaDescription: How printable wall art works: what you receive, which sizes are included, and how to print and frame your digital download.
body:
## What is a printable?

A printable is a digital file of the artwork. You buy it once, download it, and print it yourself. **No physical item is shipped**: no print, no frame.

## Where do I buy?

All purchases happen on our [Etsy shop]({{etsyShopUrl}}). Each product page on this site has a **Buy on Etsy** button that opens the exact listing. Prices are shown on Etsy.

## What will I receive?

After payment, Etsy gives you a download with access to the high-resolution JPG files, all at 300 DPI. Most designs include several ratio folders (2:3, 3:4, 4:5, 11x14 and ISO A sizes), so you can match common frame sizes. The exact list is in each product description.

## How do I print?

- Choose the file whose ratio matches your frame.
- Print at home, at a local print shop, or through an online printing service.
- Upload the original full-resolution file and choose **fit**, not **fill**, so nothing is cropped.
- Matte or heavyweight art paper works well for painterly designs.

## Will the colours look exactly like the mockups?

Colours can vary between screens, printers, inks and papers. Mockups show display ideas; frames and furniture are not included.

## Can I use the art commercially?

No. The files are for personal use only. Please see our [terms](/terms/).

## I need help with my order

Orders, downloads and refunds are handled through Etsy. Message us on Etsy from your purchase page, or write to us via the [contact page](/contact/).

title: Privacy Policy
metaDescription: How Subtle Sway handles your data: this site does not use cookies, does not run analytics and does not collect personal information.
body:
This policy explains what happens to your data when you visit **subtlesway.com** ("the site"), run by Subtle Sway ("we", "us").

## The short version

- The site does not use cookies.
- The site does not run analytics, advertising or tracking scripts.
- The site has no accounts, forms or checkout, so we do not collect personal information through it.
- All purchases happen on Etsy, under Etsy's own privacy policy.

## Hosting

The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. Like any web server, GitHub may process technical data such as your IP address to deliver the pages and keep the service secure. See the [GitHub Privacy Statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement).

## Fonts and media

Fonts, images and videos are served from this site itself. We do not load fonts or scripts from third-party services.

## Etsy

When you click **Buy on Etsy** or any Etsy link, you leave this site. Your purchase, payment, download and any messages are handled by Etsy and governed by the [Etsy Privacy Policy](https://www.etsy.com/legal/privacy/). As the seller, we receive the order details Etsy shares with sellers and use them only to fulfil and support your order.

## Email

If you email us, we use your email address and message only to reply to you. We do not add you to any mailing list.

## Your rights

Depending on where you live (for example under the UK or EU GDPR, or US state laws such as the CCPA), you may have the right to access, correct or delete personal data we hold about you. Email us at [{{contactEmail}}](mailto:{{contactEmail}}) and we will respond within 30 days.

## Children

The site is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their data.

## Changes

If this policy changes, we will update the date at the top of this page.

title: Terms of Use
metaDescription: Terms of use for subtlesway.com and the personal-use licence for Subtle Sway printable wall art.
body:
By using **subtlesway.com** you agree to these terms.

## What this site is

This site is a catalogue of our printable wall art. Nothing is sold on this site. All purchases are made on Etsy and are subject to [Etsy's Terms of Use](https://www.etsy.com/legal/terms-of-use) and the policies shown in our Etsy shop, including refunds.

## Copyright

All artwork, mockups, photos and text on this site are owned by Subtle Sway and protected by copyright. You may not copy, download, reproduce or distribute them, except to share a link to a page.

## Personal-use licence for purchased files

When you buy a printable on Etsy, you receive a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to:

- print the artwork for your own home or personal space;
- print it as a personal gift.

You may not:

- resell, share or redistribute the digital files, printed or digital;
- use the artwork on products for sale, such as prints, mugs, clothing or templates;
- use it in commercial projects, branding or advertising;
- claim the artwork as your own.

Copyright stays with Subtle Sway. For commercial licensing, please [contact us](/contact/).

## Accuracy

We try to keep every description accurate. Colours vary between screens and printers, and mockups are illustrations of how a print could look. If anything on this site differs from the Etsy listing, the Etsy listing applies.

## Links

This site links to Etsy and other websites. We are not responsible for their content or policies.

## Changes

We may update these terms. The date at the top shows the latest version.

title: Disclaimer
metaDescription: Subtle Sway is an independent shop. Digital downloads only, AI-assisted artwork, colours may vary, not affiliated with Etsy.
body:
## Independent shop

Subtle Sway is an independent shop. This site is run by us and **is not operated, sponsored or endorsed by Etsy, Inc.** "Etsy" is a trademark of Etsy, Inc. and is used here only to show where our products are sold.

## Digital downloads only

Every product shown here is a **digital file**. No physical print, frame or other item is shipped.

## Mockups

Room mockups show display ideas only. Frames, furniture, plants and decorative objects are not included.

## Colours and print results

Colours can look different on different screens, and print results depend on your printer, ink, paper and print settings. We cannot guarantee an exact colour match.

## AI-assisted artwork

Our artwork is designed by us with digital tools, including AI-assisted generation, and then edited, colour-corrected and prepared for print by us.

## Prices

Prices are shown only on Etsy and may change, including during sales. The Etsy listing is always the current price.

## No commission links

This site does not contain paid or affiliate links. Links to Etsy go to our own shop.
